name: citelayer®
author: Saskia Teichmann

sections.description:
citelayer® makes your WordPress® site visible and accessible to AI agents like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Features:

  • llms.txt Generation – Automatic llms.txt file for LLM crawlers (similar to robots.txt)
  • Schema.org Markup – JSON-LD structured data optimized for AI consumption (Organization, WebSite, Article, Product)
  • UCP Discovery – Universal Commerce Protocol endpoint for AI agents (Free version: discovery only)
  • Markdown for Agents – Serves clean Markdown instead of HTML when AI agents request it (Content Negotiation via Accept header)
  • Content-Signal Headers – Configure content usage preferences (ai-train, search, ai-input)

Why citelayer®?

AI agents are becoming a primary way users discover content and products. citelayer® ensures your site is:

  • Discoverable – AI agents can find and understand your content
  • Structured – Clean, semantic data for better AI comprehension
  • Efficient – Markdown responses use 80% fewer tokens than HTML
  • Privacy-Respecting – Control how AI systems use your content via Content-Signal headers

WooCommerce Support

If you run WooCommerce, citelayer® automatically:

  • Includes product counts in llms.txt
  • Generates Product Schema.org markup
  • Shows UCP Discovery endpoint (full UCP support in Premium version)
  • Renders product pages as structured Markdown tables

Free vs. Premium

The free version provides essential AI visibility features. Premium adds:

  • Full UCP product browsing, cart, and checkout
  • AI Visibility Monitoring Dashboard
  • Advanced Schema.org markup (Reviews, FAQ, Shipping)
  • Product feed optimization tools

Learn more about Premium →
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/citelayer/ or install via WordPress plugin installer
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → citelayer® to configure options
  4. Test your setup by visiting /llms.txt on your site
sections.faq:
What is llms.txt?

llms.txt is a proposed standard (similar to robots.txt) that helps LLM crawlers understand your site structure. It provides AI agents with essential information about your content, products, and capabilities.

Does this plugin affect my SEO?

Yes, positively! The Schema.org markup improves how search engines understand your content. The plugin detects Yoast SEO and Rank Math to avoid duplicate schema output.

What is UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol)?

UCP is a new standard by Google and Shopify that lets AI agents browse products, add to cart, and checkout. The free version shows AI agents that your shop could support UCP. Full UCP implementation requires Premium.

Will this slow down my site?

No. All features use aggressive caching (24h for llms.txt, 7 days for Schema). Markdown generation adds ~5-15ms when AI agents request it (1ms when cached).

What are Content-Signal headers?

Content-Signal headers (contentsignals.org) let you control how AI systems use your content:
* ai-train – Allow/deny use for training models
* search – Allow/deny search indexing
* ai-input – Allow/deny use for RAG/context

Default: Training denied, search and RAG allowed.
